skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Search/filter · install/uninstall · enable/disable · consistent feedback.

skills.marketSectionSub: Browse a controlled HTTPS index; install still runs via OpenClaw CLI. Falls back to a bundled catalog if the network fails.
skills.marketSourceHint: Data source: by default we fetch this repo’s index from GitHub Raw; if that’s unreachable, we automatically try jsDelivr (same JSON, often easier from China). If both fail, the bundled catalog is used. You can also set CLAWFLOW_SKILL_MARKET_URL to a self-hosted JSON (e.g. on Gitee) and CLAWFLOW_SKILL_MARKET_EXTRA_HOSTS for extra allowed hostnames.
skills.marketEmpty: No marketplace items or no search matches.
